title.zh: 科学探究之必要关系基础
title.en: Necessary relational foundation of scientific inquiry

claim.zh: 待完成：从独立说明的科学成就及同一展开的真实关系，证明完整所提核心在所声明科学范围内不可缺少，不以接受核心定义充分性。
claim.en: Open: establish the indispensability of the full proposed core across the intended scientific scope from independently stated achievements and actual relationships within one unfolding, without defining adequacy as acceptance of the core.

hypotheses.zh: 用户明确要求完成必要科学基础；已完成局部定理直接复用，完整理论及伦理普遍性保留不同范围。
hypotheses.en: The user explicitly requests completing the necessary scientific foundation; reuse completed local theorems and distinguish whole-theory and ethical universality.

correspondence.zh: 逐项说明核心承诺与科学问题的连接；表示差异不自动否定共同基础，局部必要性也不自动证明完整基础。
correspondence.en: Map each core commitment to a scientific question; differences of representation do not refute a common foundation, and local necessity does not prove the whole foundation.

detail.zh: 已证可错辨别约束为核心映射提供输入；整个核心的映射和范围仍未完成。
detail.en: The checked fallible-discrimination constraint supplies an input to the core mapping; mapping and scope of the full core remain unfinished.

detail.zh: 复用同一接合的共同结构结果，不把它升级为所有科学解释已满足其问题范围。
detail.en: Reuse the common-structure result for one joining law without assuming that all scientific explanations undertake its question scope.

detail.zh: 有限自然数权重、完整读数、共同规则及实际概率对应明示；没有校准真实法则或证明整个核心的科学普遍必要性。
detail.en: Finite natural weights, complete readouts, a common rule and actual probability correspondence are explicit; no calibration of actual laws or science-wide necessity of the whole core is proved.

limitations.zh: 有限自然数权重、完整读数、共同规则及实际概率对应明示；没有校准真实法则或证明整个核心的科学普遍必要性。
limitations.en: Finite natural weights, complete readouts, a common rule and actual probability correspondence are explicit; no calibration of actual laws or science-wide necessity of the whole core is proved.

validation_scope.zh: 登记未完成的普遍目标和本轮确立的有限推进；不是新的普遍定理或不可能性结论。
validation_scope.en: Records the unfinished universal target and this round’s finite advance, not a new universal theorem or impossibility result.

next_delta.zh: 明确尚需科学普遍必要性证明的核心承诺，并给出独立问题、对应及真正对手；不把此次局部证明升级为全理论完成。
next_delta.en: Identify the further core commitment requiring a science-wide necessity proof, with an independent task, correspondence and substantive rival; do not upgrade this local proof to whole-theory completion.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：按最新明确完成请求登记本会话目标；条件形式进展和普遍完成分开。
history.en: 2026-10-08: records this session’s latest explicit completion request, separating conditional formal progress from universal completion.

history.zh: 2026-10-12 P73：归纳的规律在第一部分陈述，不用公理：无记录固定下一个，每个学习者都有否证它每个主张的开放的序列，被列表所持的世界中按否证学习的否证有界、静止不能被否证（learning-by-refutation）；推广恰在世界经模型所归并者同去之处正确（generalization-through-lumping）；见整合文档 §92。它们是科学探究的必要关系的一部分，不证明完整核心对科学的不可或缺性；断言与 next_delta 不变。
history.en: 2026-10-12 P73: the laws of induction are stated in Part I with no axiom: no record fixes the next value, every learner has an open course refuting each of its claims, and in a world held by a list learning by refutation is refuted a bounded number of times with its rest unrefuted (learning-by-refutation); a generalization is right exactly where the world goes alike across what the model lumps (generalization-through-lumping); see §92 of the integration note. They are part of the necessary relations of scientific inquiry and do not prove the whole core indispensable to science; the claim and next_delta are unchanged.
